name: balseraphs_settler
description: a Balseraph Settler, a young jester traveller: spiky red hair, a green, purple and gold harlequin-diamond tunic with a purple collar and gold bells, a brown belt and brown boots, a huge backpack on his back with a purple-and-gold striped bedroll on top, a white comedy mask and a red drum hanging on its screen-left side, and a tall wooden walking staff with a curled top and a brass bell in his LEFT hand on the screen-right side; it is his only weapon
hands: the walking staff stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand is an empty fist on the screen-left side, at rest gripping the backpack strap

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the right hand lets go of the pack strap, the walking staff is lifted up over the head with its curled top pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the walking staff cocked behind the head with its curled top hanging down behind the shoulders beside the backpack, the empty right fist tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the walking staff is level, its curled top pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: staff arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the walking staff's curled top swinging down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty right fist swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the walking staff carries on down until its curled top nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the red hair trailing back, the backpack still on his back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the walking staff lifts back toward the ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, the staff arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the walking staff dipping, the empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, staff arm flung up, the empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the walking staff lowering, the backpack weighing on his back
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the walking staff's curled top resting on the ground, the empty right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the walking staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back on top of the big backpack, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the walking staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the bedroll, the comedy mask and the drum beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the backpack settles under him
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the backpack under him, the walking staff on the ground beside him
